statement: The meta for people just entering World 4 is purple mushroom into TVs into Genie.

creator: pulseidle
statement: With four guards and command rank 7 you can connect to everything on the map, so you should be good to go.

statement: Alternative tech: on entering World 4, skip to TVs immediately without doing purple mushroom.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Unlocking the World 4 commander in Kingdom Sovereignty auto-unlocks the first node (purple mushroom) without clearing it. This is about 30 million free.

creator: pulseidle
statement: For him the tech was not ideal: unlocking earlier would have given the egg resource, then militia, then faster TV and Genie outpost clears.

creator: pulseidle
statement: If you reach World 4 slowly and are close to the commander upgrade, the tech is good, provided you haven't upgraded another node such as TV or Genie.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Even if TV is finished and shows the build outpost icon, don't click it; the tech still gives the first outpost free.

creator: pulseidle
statement: The tech may not be much faster but has little downside and could be much faster. He recommends doing it.
